name: FPI
recent: Formosa Prosonic 以 RM22.1 million 出售位于 Sungai Petani 的工厂，并将生产集中到 Port Klang。公司宣布多项董事会变动，Cheong Hong Yip 被重新任命为董事经理。最新季度净利为 RM10.2 million。
notable: 以 RM22.1 million 出售位于 Sungai Petani 的工厂，并将生产集中到 Port Klang。
Cheong Hong Yip 被重新任命为董事经理。
多名董事及大股东在 9 月进行股权交易，包括 Shih Chao Yuan 出售股份。
risks: 集团董事经理 Shih Chao Yuan 在 9 月 10 日及 11 日通过直接商业交易出售直接及视为权益股份。
独立非执行主席 Leong Ngai Seng 在 9 月 11 日以 RM1.15 收购 7,663,300 股股份。
earnings: 最近一季（2026-06-30）营收为 RM182.95 million，净利为 RM13.924 million，净利率 7.6%。营收环比增长 134.3%，净利环比增长 438.9%；营收同比增长 66.7%。

recent_en: Formosa Prosonic is selling its Sungai Petani factory for RM22.1 million and consolidating production in Port Klang. The company announced several boardroom changes, with Cheong Hong Yip redesignated as managing director. Latest quarterly net profit was RM10.2 million.
notable_en: Selling the Sungai Petani factory for RM22.1 million and consolidating production in Port Klang.
Cheong Hong Yip was redesignated as managing director.
Several directors and substantial shareholders conducted share transactions in September, including disposals by Shih Chao Yuan.
risks_en: Group Managing Director Shih Chao Yuan disposed of direct and deemed interest shares via direct business transactions on 10 and 11 September.
Independent Non-Executive Chairman Leong Ngai Seng acquired 7,663,300 shares at RM1.15 on 11 September.
earnings_en: For the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM182.95 million and net profit was RM13.924 million, with a net margin of 7.6%. Revenue rose 134.3% QoQ and net profit rose 438.9% QoQ; revenue grew 66.7% YoY.
